questions.question: On a road with no sidewalks, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: On the side with the lightest traffic.
On the same side where traffic is moving.
On the side facing oncoming traffic.
On the side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road where you can see traffic coming toward you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots when changing lanes?

options.text: Use both inside and outside rearview mirrors.
Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check blind spots before every lane change.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down once you move onto the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same on the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down once you move onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until you are on the exit ramp itself.

questions.question: What is the minimum age to get a motorcycle instruction permit?
questions.explanation: You must be at least 15 and one-half years old to apply for a motorcycle instruction permit.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop and look, then go if the road is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to cross the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful as you continue through the intersection.

questions.question: What is true about a work zone?

options.text: It can be moving or stationary.
It is marked with black and white signs.
You do not need to slow down or pay extra attention.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can be moving or stationary.
questions.explanation: Work zones can be stationary or moving, such as vehicles that stripe lines, mow, or remove snow. Work zones use orange signs with black letters or symbols. Always slow down and stay alert in work zones.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are small and easy to miss. They can hide in a car's blind spot. It is hard to judge distance and speed with motorcycles, so always be alert and careful around them.

questions.question: What color are road markings that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines in the center of the road separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing without traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will never happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At an unmarked railroad crossing, slow down and be ready to stop. Look both ways on all tracks before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait for it to pass before crossing.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Signal as you start to move into the next lane.
Signal 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets.

questions.explanation: Other cars and motorcycles can hide in your blind spot. Look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before changing lanes on residential streets. Signal 5 seconds before changing lanes on a freeway.

questions.question: When entering a freeway, what should you do?

options.text: Go slowly and wait for an opening.
Speed up faster than the freeway traffic.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up to match freeway traffic. This helps you blend in smoothly and safely. You must yield to traffic already on the freeway.

questions.question: What color are warning signs?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about unexpected conditions ahead.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, what should you do?

options.text: Always drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Follow the car ahead more closely.
Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery surfaces. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used in traffic signals.
It means the same thing as a red circular traffic light.
It means you can turn in the direction the arrow points.
It means traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a red circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red circular light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly and do not have Anti-Lock Brakes (ABS), what should you do?

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal.

questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop in an emergency. Your car will stop quickly and you can still steer.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Get ready to stop because the light is about to turn red.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means go slowly and look both ways. Check for traffic in all directions before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout pass first.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. Which lane should you be in?

options.text: The lane with the least traffic.

questions.explanation: When turning left onto a one-way street, finish your turn in the left lane. This is closest to the lane you came from.

questions.question: What do pentagonal signs mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones. Watch carefully for children and pedestrians when you see this sign.

questions.question: Which is NOT a factor in how far it takes to stop your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. Speed and road conditions affect these factors.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Always check your mirrors and turn on your signal. Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: What should you do at an uncontrolled intersection?

options.text: Stop at the intersection, look in all directions, and proceed.

questions.explanation: At an uncontrolled intersection with no stop sign or traffic light, yield to vehicles coming from the right. Always be ready to yield to avoid a crash. Slow down, cover your brake, and check left, right, and left again.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead. Prepare to stop completely.
